learning_objective: 🎯 We will discover fun action words that describe all the amazing things we can do!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Action words tell us what a person animal or thing is doing right now. They make our sentences come alive.
When you run in the park or jump on your bed you are doing an action. Run and jump are fun action words!

fun_activity.title: 📸 Action Freeze
fun_activity.instructions: Dance around your room. When someone says Freeze you must freeze in an action pose like running or flying!

quick_recap: ⭐ Action words show what someone is doing.
⭐ Singing dancing and jumping are all action words.
⭐ Action words are also known as doing words or verbs.
